answer: When the panel doubts everything else, Calligrapher letters patent proof lettered across the chancery office still stands, and its standing is each letters patent is a sheet record witnessed by the inspector. For every honest agent the terrace is aged, the cipher is settled, and the timber is long; for every farm the three are fresh, borrowed, and blank. Two separate readers reaching the same answer is the whole of the check. The threshold charges in days as well as coins: 6 days to cure a proof, and a farm cannot cure 665 proofs any faster.
